name: Dispatch
description: Warm editorial theme — cream paper (#FAF7F4) and ink (#252525) with a confident azure-blue action colour and a highlighter-yellow 'important' accent. Type: a slab-serif display (Zilla Slab Light), a clean geometric-sans heading (Geist SemiBold), and a hyperlegible body (Atkinson Hyperlegible). Apply class="a1-theme-dispatch" to <html>.
